name: Hardware-Adapted Object-Order Ray Casting
aliases: Hardware-Adapted Object-Order Ray Casting (Hong et al.)
Object-Order Ray-Casting with Efficient Ray-Cell Intersection
definition: An adaptation of object-order ray casting for current graphics hardware where fragments are generated for rays intersecting cells, with order given by min/max octrees.
summary: Hardware-Adapted Object-Order Ray Casting is a volume rendering technique optimized for graphics hardware that generates fragments for rays intersecting volume cells using pre-computed projection lists and min/max octrees.
